title: 你真的有自我吗？

timeline.summary: He argues that pretending interest and agreeing with everything to obtain sex shows a lack of self and predicts the other person will notice and gain leverage.
He tells viewers not to say things against their own beliefs, says he would rather fail than ingratiate himself, and then uses demeaning language to condemn people-pleasing.
He describes his own style as rarely researching a woman's interests for topics because he has his own work, while acknowledging that others may do so.
He links a commanding presence to a big heart, restraint, calmness and self-control.
